acceptance.name: Start elevation 175–182 m (Brady St at 4th St; lidar 178 m)
Finish elevation 170–177 m (3rd St; lidar 173 m)
Highest point 213–221 m (the top of Brady St and Kirkwood Blvd)
Brady Street Hill rises 32–44 m in the first half-mile (lidar +38 m)
Brady Street Hill survives as a climb of ≥ +6% (the organiser: "about a 7 to 9% grade … for around one third of a mile")
Jersey Ridge Rd up to McClellan Heights survives as a climb of ≥ +6%
The climb back up McClellan Blvd from the turnaround survives as ≥ +3.5%

description: Straight up Brady Street Hill from the gun, about a third of a mile at 7–9%, then out along the Kirkwood Boulevard rollers, up Jersey Ridge Road and down McClellan Boulevard to a turnaround at River Drive, and back the same way to a downhill finish downtown. Unofficial.
name: Bix 7

source.notes: Brady St from 4th St up Brady Street Hill, Kirkwood Blvd, Jersey Ridge Rd, Middle Rd and McClellan Blvd to a turnaround at River Dr, back the same way, and left onto 3rd St to the finish near Iowa St, as described by the organiser and on its course and start-line maps. Route traced over OpenStreetMap streets; the course is USATF-certified but no splits are published, so distance is calibrated to the finish (OSM traces about 1% long on the curves of Kirkwood and McClellan). Elevations from USGS 3DEP lidar (Iowa 2008 and 2019, Illinois 2019); the railroad underpass on Brady St is interpolated. Unofficial.
